examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Cloudflare comparison as the migration guide places it: six categories, each capability with a definition behind its info button and a support glyph per platform. The header row stays pinned while the page scrolls. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no groups renders nothing at all.
examples.sfc:
